help.title: Help
help.lead: How to operate this stack from the dashboard, connect applications, and find documentation.
about.title: About
about.lead: Build identity, licences, and what this instance is running.
help.api_blurb: Every dashboard change is one dbpantry command via POST /api/v1/jobs (CSRF + same scopes as the CLI). Full write-up: docs/reference/api.md in the checkout.
help.api_jobs: start a named action as a job
nav.no_jobs: No jobs yet — start one from any page.
status.title: Status
status.lead: Services, engines, jobs and how live refresh reports health.
status.refresh_blurb: The header Live control pauses or resumes the five-second page refresh. Its colour tells you whether the dashboard can reach itself.
overview.lead: Welcome back — here's your stack overview for today.
envs.title: Environments
envs.lead: Each environment is its own instance home (MDB_HOME) with a type — localdev, dev, test, qa, uat, trn, spt, stg, preprod, demo, sandbox, prod (aliases: prd, tst, …). Copy and migrate move a database via backup + restore.
envs.empty: No environments registered yet. Create one with a type, then copy or migrate databases between homes.
addons.title: Add-ons
addons.lead: Poolers, PostgreSQL extensions, embed toggles and UIs the stack already ships. Unsupported items stay listed but cannot be enabled.
addons.engine_hint: Enabled engines first. A disabled engine can still be selected — enable its profile before the add-on can run.
addons.engine_footer: Single selects one engine; Multiple lets you filter several. All engines shows the full catalog.
addons.mode_single_tip: Select one engine at a time
addons.mode_multi_tip: Select several engines to filter the catalog
addons.all_tip: Clear selection and show every engine’s add-ons
addons.catalog_empty_hint: Pick a different engine or clear the selection.
addons.review_hint: Each change runs as a scoped dbpantry job (same confirms as the CLI).
addons.review_empty: No changes queued. Use Queue on/off in the catalog, then apply here.
addons.preload_note: One or more extensions need shared_preload_libraries — restart PostgreSQL after enabling.
addons.preload_tip: shared_preload_libraries change — restart PostgreSQL after apply
addons.engines_tip: Open Engines to enable profiles or start services
addons.need_engine: Select one engine, or choose All engines
addons.need_engines: Select at least one engine, or choose All engines
addons.need_queue: Queue a change in the catalog first
addons.off_banner: Selected engines that are off need their profile enabled before add-ons can run: %s
addons.engine_off_tip: Profile off — enable it on the Engines page before add-ons can run
addons.engine_stopped_tip: Profile on, service stopped — start the stack or this engine first
addons.queue_on_tip: Add enable to the review queue (applied in step 3)
addons.queue_off_tip: Add disable to the review queue (applied in step 3)
